graph.title: Speed Boat (LEGO City 4641-1)

edges.method: stud/anti-stud, ends of the 6x1 slope piece clip onto the 6x4 slope piece
hull bottom's rear end engages the studs of the recessed 1x4 / p8 (attached beside, same level)
anti-studs of the hull clutch the studs of the 1x4 brick at the hull rear
round boat-stud plate pressed onto the underside studs of the hull (step 10, boat turned over)
round boat-stud plate pressed onto the underside studs of the hull
round boat-stud plate pressed onto the underside studs of the hull
grille tile pressed sideways onto side studs of the 1x2 brick with studs on 2 sides
grille tile pressed sideways onto the other side studs of the 1x2 brick with studs on 2 sides
inverted slope pushed up onto the underside of the clip plate (motor sub-assembly step 5)
clip on end of plate clips onto the handle (bar) of the white brick at the stern (main step 14)

notes: Step numbering: main steps 1-13 = steps 1-13; the 5-step outboard motor sub-assembly (booklet p.15-16) = steps 14-18; main step 14 (clip motor on) = step 19 and main step 15 (minifigure in boat) = step 20. No listed piece is added in steps 19-20; the minifigure (p.2) is not part of the piece list.

Booklet shows no per-step parts callouts, so the assignment of pieces to steps comes from the pictures. Uncertain: p9 (red 2x2 plate), p24/p25 (red grille slopes) and p29/p3 (wedge and tile); they were all assigned to steps 11 and 12.

Coordinates: x runs from bow (0) to stern; y across the 6-stud beam. The hull (p27/p28) is 10 long and 6 wide; the stern base p22 is modelled as a 6 x 4 block (x 11-16, y 1-4, layers 1-4) with the 6x1 piece p18 across its front end at x=10. Everything in its recess (steering stand, handle tile, handle brick, cheese slopes) is placed on top of p22 at layer 4, and the red 1x6 plates sit on its two long rows (y=1 and y=4).
Layer 0 is the three black round boat-stud plates under the hull; all other pieces are shifted up by one.
The red curved 6x1 bricks are placed from x=13, so they overhang the stern end of the plates and stay clear of the windscreen.

Motor: the booklet builds p26 first (step 14) and pushes the inverted slope p11 up onto its underside later (step 18). Since a piece cannot rest on one added later, p11 is given no grid position and rests_on [] and is recorded only as a join to p26 (other_joins). p1/p2 are fixed on side studs so also have no grid position. The motor is placed notionally behind the stern and clips onto the white handle brick p10 in step 19.
Some cell overlaps are approximate because the small images do not show exact stud alignment.
